title: Baby Leo and Friends Learn About Feeling Emotions
summary: Today, Baby Leo and friends learn about feelings! Bella has a special game to help everyone understand their emotions. Together, they discover how to express and share their feelings in a kind and caring way.
lesson: Kids learn about different emotions and how to express them.
beats: Baby Leo, Bella, Bobo, Marjona, and Twinkle gather in a sunny meadow. They remember the fun of their last adventure and decide to play a new game today.
Bella introduces the game called 'Feelings Faces.' She shows them cards with different faces showing happiness, sadness, anger, and surprise.
Baby Leo asks, 'Why do we have feelings?' Bella explains that feelings help us understand ourselves and each other.
Marjona picks a card showing happiness and jumps up singing joyfully. 'This is how I feel!' she sings.
Bobo picks a card with a sad face. He shares, 'I feel sad when I miss my snack!' The friends laugh and decide to help him find a snack.
Twinkle shows a card with a surprised face and says, 'I feel surprised when I see something new!' The friends wonder about new things they can explore.
The friends take turns picking cards and express their feelings. They find out it’s okay to feel different things.
Bella suggests they help each other feel better! They all give Bobo a warm hug, cheering him up.
The friends end their game, smiling and happy. They learn that sharing feelings can make everyone feel good.
They sing a happy song together, celebrating their friendship and the power of emotions.
